items.title: Daniel Jones: Getting Allen back in Week 5
items.text:
Jones will welcome back Keenan Allen (groin) to his wide-receiver corps in Sunday's Week 5 matchup against the Steelers, as the latter is active for the contest.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaylen Warren: Full control of backfield again Sunday
items.text:
Warren will remain the Steelers' unquestioned lead back in Sunday's Week 5 matchup against the Colts due to Rico Dowdle (toe) having been declared inactive for the contest.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Terry McLaurin: Good to go Week 5
items.text:
McLaurin (hamstring) is officially active for Sunday's game against the Giants.

items.title: Will Shipley: Won't return to Sunday's game
items.text:
The Eagles ruled out Shipley (foot) for the remainder of Sunday's game versus the Jaguars in London.
